name: Frigid Crest
look: a long-legged blue feathered raptor with an icy breast, a black-masked head with a hooked beak and a huge swept-back violet crest, icy feather fringes and an enormous looping violet plume of a tail
entry: A Pokémon resembling Articuno, described in an old field journal about a frozen valley where a feathered beast stalked the snowdrifts. It fans its great plume to frighten rivals, and the air round its crest glitters with frost.
how: Wild: very rare in snowy forests and snowy taigas.
